title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Minimum Claim Amount
content:
Each tier of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` pays nothing on claims smaller than its minimum claim amount.

## Rule

A claim whose amount is below the tier's minimum claim amount is rejected as below the minimum claim. The amount compared is the amount claimed on the claim file.

| Tier | Minimum claim amount (USD per claim) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 100.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 100.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 250.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 150.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 100.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 50.00 |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical amounts)

- Under `AHL CargoCare Essential`, 249.99 USD is below the minimum and meets this ground; 250.00 USD is not below it and does not.
- Under `AHL CargoCare Total`, 50.00 USD does not meet this ground, while 49.99 USD does.
- The same amount can meet the ground under one tier and not another: 120.00 USD is below the minimum of `AHL CargoCare Plus` but not below that of `AHL Declared Value Liability`.
